text:
Renee: Quick update — AV just reported the encoder box overheated. We're moving the livestream to the backup encoder and swapping presenters. Expect a 7-9m delay. Put Qs here.
Tomas: Acknowledged. Presenters, please queue in Room C and hand HDMI to Ben when you arrive.
Ivy: Can we push the roadmap Q&A to immediately after intros? We have a partner in APAC that needs early visibility.
Renee: Agreed, roadmap first after intros. Also we9ll do a 2-min warning before each Q&A block.
StreamBot: backup-encoder activated -> enc-backup-3 ; rtmp bridge: rtmp://backup.stream/redwood_key ; recording enabled.
Ben: I uploaded revised slides (v6) to /handouts/allhands/2026-04-10-roadmap-v6.pdf. Note: removed the heavy animation that was killing the encoder.
Harper: If the live demo is flaky, I'll capture the terminal session and stitch a short clip. Command: `ffmpeg -video_size 1366x768 -framerate 30 -f x11grab -i :0.0 -c:v libx264 /tmp/demo_clip.mp4`
Samira: Captioning might lag ~12s while we switch sources. I'm priming the caption engine now; will monitor drift and post updates.
Tomas: Action items: 1) Room move + encoder swap -> Renee/Ben. 2) Slides updated -> Ben. 3) Roadmap frontloaded -> Ivy/Tomas. 4) Demo capture fallback -> Harper. 5) Timestamps during stream -> Samira.
Ben: Presenters, please confirm you're in Room C with adapters. If you need a dongle, grab one from the AV cart.
Ivy: Leadership will take the first 8 minutes of roadmap questions, then open floor for product/general Qs. We'll capture unanswered Qs in a follow-up doc.
Samira: Ready to log timestamps and post markers to the notes doc: https://redwood/internal/allhands/2026-04-10/notes. I'll paste markers here as they happen.
Renee: Going to call "go" in 4m. If anyone sees audio dropouts, post here immediately.
All: :thumbsup:
